title: A Banach space with an unconditional basis which is not slicely countably determined
summary: In this note, we study the geometry of the unit ball of the Banach space generated by the adequate family of all subsets of branches of the infinite binary tree, and answer several open questions related to slicely countably determined Banach spaces. Our main result is that the binary tree space is an example of a Banach space with an unconditional basis which fails to be slicely countably determined.
